# GitHub Copilot — read AGENTS.md

The canonical rules for this repo live in **[`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md)** at the repo root.
Read it before editing. Key rules: prototypes are standalone HTML (no build step, no frameworks);
design standard is POP/FIESTA — reuse existing tokens/classes, don't invent new ones;
every `data-go` must resolve to a real `#s-` section; push only once direction is agreed.

Do not maintain a separate context here — if something changes, update `AGENTS.md`, not this file.
